title: Beyond Modeling Order: Dual-Path Spatiotemporal Representation Learning for Cross-Subject EEG Emotion Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2610.35540v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cross-subject generalization remains a major challenge for EEG-based emotion recognition due to pronounced inter-subject variability in neural activity and emotion-related spatiotemporal patterns. Existing methods mainly alleviate inter subject differences through distribution alignment or contrastive learning, while paying limited attention to representation bias associated with fixed spatiotemporal modeling orders. We hypothesize that high-level emotion representations of the same EEG signal should remain consistent across different spatiotemporal modeling paths. Based on this hypothesis, we propose a Dual-Path Spatiotemporal Contrastive Learning (DP-STCL) framework for cross-subject EEG emotion recognition. DP-STCL employs two complementary encoders with independent parameters, namely a Temporal-to-Spatial (TS) path and a Spatial to-Temporal (ST) path, to model EEG spatiotemporal information under different integration orders. translated_title: 超越建模顺序：面向跨被试脑电情绪识别的双路径时空表征学习
translated_abstract: 由于被试间神经活动和情绪相关时空模式的显著差异，跨被试泛化仍然是基于脑电（EEG）情绪识别的主要挑战。现有方法主要通过分布对齐或对比学习来缓解被试间差异，而对与固定时空建模顺序相关的表征偏差关注有限。我们假设同一脑电信号的高级情绪表征在不同的时空建模路径下应保持一致。基于这一假设，我们提出了一种用于跨被试脑电情绪识别的双路径时空对比学习（DP-STCL）框架。DP-STCL采用两个具有独立参数的互补编码器，即时间到空间（TS）路径和空间到时间（ST）路径，以不同的整合顺序对脑电时空信息进行建模。在……
tldr: 提出双路径时空对比学习框架DP-STCL，通过“时间到空间”与“空间到时间”两条互补建模路径间的表征一致性约束，消除固定建模顺序带来的偏差，从而提升跨被试脑电情绪识别的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: The proposed Dual-Path Spatiotemporal Contrastive Learning (DP-STCL) framework enforces consistency between Temporal-to-Spatial and Spatial-to-Temporal encoders to remove bias from fixed modeling orders, thereby improving cross-subject generalization in EEG emotion recognition.
